issue.title: bob ref doctor: flag reference id/stem mismatches and duplicate ids, then repair the live vault through bob ref rename

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add `bob ref doctor` diagnostics for reference identity, which `decisions:reference-ids-follow-file-stems`
requires: (1) a note whose frontmatter `id` differs from its note stem, and (2) the same id
(case-insensitive) recorded by more than one note anywhere under `ref/`. Each diagnostic should
name the `bob ref rename` repair. Then repair the live vault through `bob ref rename`
(never by hand-editing ids). A read-only scan on 2026-10-23 found 437 notes with ids, 1
duplicate id, and 3 stem mismatches:

- `ref/papers/BryanBugyi_CV_extended_v2.md` records id `BryanBugyi_CV_extended`, which
  duplicates `ref/papers/BryanBugyi_CV_extended.md` (rename previously refused `not_in_sync`).
- `ref/papers/harness_engineering.md` records id `harness_engineering_2`. The id is
  correctly suffixed because `ref/blogs/harness_engineering.md` owns the base, so the stem
  should become `harness_engineering_2`.
- `ref/chat/obsidian_sync_footprint_audit_bob-cli-1l.md` records id
  `obsidian_sync_footprint_audit_bob-cli-1l.1_20260827`.

bob-cli-an.6.5 (commit 9885bde1) fixed creation, so new references always record their
stem and default creation reserves ids across all of `ref/`. Existing data was deliberately
left to `bob ref rename`. bob-cli-8o's 2026-10-17 note listed this doctor check as optional
remaining scope.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
Epic bob-cli-an.6's ref-id-allocation phase owned only creation-time allocation, and its plan
said "Do not re-key existing references; bob ref rename owns repairs." A doctor diagnostic is a
discretionary feature that the phase contract did not authorize, and the live repairs mutate
the vault. Both need their own reviewed task.

issue.creation_reason: Remaining optional scope from bob-cli-8o (note #1), not authorized by bob-cli-an.6.5's creation-only contract; a live scan still finds 1 duplicate id and 3 id/stem mismatches.

Note the earlier not_in_sync refusal for the CV_extended_v2 rename.
